extension.summary: Functional: a clean, opinionated Kodi skin
extension.description: Functional. Built for clarity: gallery library views, configurable accent colour, slide-out filters, side-by-side library stats on home, and a tight video OSD.
extension.news: Your lists can now be managed from the JellyStat dashboard on a phone or laptop: make and delete lists, rename them, turn Remove Watched on or off, search the library to add films, whole shows or episodes, put the items in order or take them off, and back up or restore every list. The TV's Lists screen shows each change at once. It needs JellyStat 0.27.0 or later on the same box, and can be switched off in Skin Settings, Lists, which is the page that used to be called Radarr.
